citation: Wolever TMS, et al. Decreasing the RAG:SAG ratio of granola cereal predictably reduces postprandial glucose and insulin responses: a report of four randomised trials in healthy adults. J Nutr Sci 2022.
protocol: Fasted; granola cereal test meals matched for fat, protein and available carbohydrate (composition in Table 1); capillary glucose and serum insulin at 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 105, 120, 150, 180 min
population: n=40 in each of four crossover studies (n=160 total), healthy adults
note: Large n and a printed composition at three hours; areas over 2-3 h are the late part. Values are given as mean plus-minus a spread the paper may not label (SEM expected): do not enter without finding the label.
